dashboard.label: Credential Stuffing Detection — Cloudflare Logpush
dashboard.description: Correlates Cloudflare Logpush HTTP Requests and Firewall Events datasets to detect credential stuffing and account takeover attacks.

search.query: index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" EdgeResponseStatus>=400 EdgeResponseStatus<500 | stats count AS total

index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:firewall_events" (ClientRequestPath="/login" OR ClientRequestPath="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestPath="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" (Action="block" OR Action="drop" OR Action="challenge" OR Action="managed_challenge") | stats count AS total

index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" EdgeResponseStatus>=400 EdgeResponseStatus<500 | stats count BY ClientIP | where count > 50 | stats dc(ClientIP) AS attacker_ips

index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" | stats sum(eval(if(EdgeResponseStatus>=400 AND EdgeResponseStatus<500,1,0))) AS failures sum(eval(if(EdgeResponseStatus>=200 AND EdgeResponseStatus<300,1,0))) AS successes BY ClientIP | where failures > 20 AND successes > 0 | stats count AS ato_count

index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" | eval status_bucket=case( EdgeResponseStatus>=200 AND EdgeResponseStatus<300, "Success (2xx)", EdgeResponseStatus>=400 AND EdgeResponseStatus<500, "Client Error (4xx)", EdgeResponseStatus>=500, "Server Error (5xx)", 1=1, "Other") | timechart span=5m count BY status_bucket

index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:firewall_events" (ClientRequestPath="/login" OR ClientRequestPath="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestPath="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" | timechart span=5m count BY Action

table.title: 🏴 Top Offending IPs — HTTP Failed Logins

search.query: index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" EdgeResponseStatus>=400 EdgeResponseStatus<500 | stats count AS failed_attempts dc(ClientRequestHost) AS targeted_hosts values(ClientCountry) AS countries values(ClientASN) AS asn latest(_time) AS last_seen earliest(_time) AS first_seen BY ClientIP | where failed_attempts > 50 | eval duration_min=round((last_seen-first_seen)/60,2) | eval rate_per_min=round(failed_attempts/max(duration_min,1),2) | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - failed_attempts | head 25 | rename ClientIP AS "Source IP", failed_attempts AS "Failed Attempts", targeted_hosts AS "Hosts Hit", countries AS "Country", asn AS "ASN", rate_per_min AS "Rate/Min"

table.title: 🛡️ Top IPs Blocked by Firewall on Login

search.query: index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:firewall_events" (ClientRequestPath="/login" OR ClientRequestPath="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestPath="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" (Action="block" OR Action="drop" OR Action="challenge" OR Action="managed_challenge" OR Action="jschallenge") | stats count AS blocked_attempts values(Action) AS actions values(Source) AS rule_sources values(RuleID) AS rule_ids values(ClientCountry) AS countries values(ClientASN) AS asn BY ClientIP, ClientRequestHost | sort - blocked_attempts | head 25 | rename ClientIP AS "Source IP", ClientRequestHost AS "Target Host", blocked_attempts AS "Blocked Attempts", actions AS "Actions", rule_sources AS "Rule Source", rule_ids AS "Rule IDs", countries AS "Country", asn AS "ASN"

table.title: 🚨 Potential Account Takeovers — Success After Many Failures

search.query: index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" | stats sum(eval(if(EdgeResponseStatus>=400 AND EdgeResponseStatus<500,1,0))) AS failures sum(eval(if(EdgeResponseStatus>=200 AND EdgeResponseStatus<300,1,0))) AS successes values(ClientCountry) AS countries values(ClientASN) AS asn latest(ClientRequestUserAgent) AS last_ua latest(_time) AS last_seen BY ClientIP, ClientRequestHost | where failures > 20 AND successes > 0 | eval severity=case( failures>500 AND successes>0, "CRITICAL", failures>100 AND successes>0, "HIGH", failures>20 AND successes>0, "MEDIUM", 1=1, "LOW") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - failures | rename ClientIP AS "Source IP", ClientRequestHost AS "Target", failures AS "Failures", successes AS "Successes", severity AS "Severity", last_ua AS "Last User Agent"

table.title: ⚠️ Firewall Bypass — IPs Blocked But Still Got Through

search.query: index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:firewall_events" (ClientRequestPath="/login" OR ClientRequestPath="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestPath="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" (Action="block" OR Action="drop" OR Action="challenge") | stats dc(RayID) AS firewall_blocks BY ClientIP | join type=inner ClientIP [search index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" EdgeResponseStatus>=200 EdgeResponseStatus<300 | stats count AS successful_requests BY ClientIP] | where successful_requests > 0 | sort - firewall_blocks | rename ClientIP AS "Source IP", firewall_blocks AS "Firewall Blocks", successful_requests AS "Successful Logins ⚠️"

index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" BotScore<=30 | eval bot_category=case( BotScore<=1, "Automated (0-1)", BotScore<=10, "Very Likely Bot (2-10)", BotScore<=30, "Likely Bot (11-30)") | stats count AS attempts dc(ClientIP) AS unique_ips dc(ClientASN) AS unique_asns avg(BotScore) AS avg_score values(BotScoreSrc) AS score_sources BY ClientRequestHost, bot_category | eval avg_score=round(avg_score,1) | sort - attempts | rename ClientRequestHost AS "Target", bot_category AS "Bot Category", attempts AS "Attempts", unique_ips AS "Unique IPs", avg_score AS "Avg Score"

index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" EdgeResponseStatus>=400 EdgeResponseStatus<500 | stats count BY ClientCountry | sort - count | head 15

index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" EdgeResponseStatus>=400 EdgeResponseStatus<500 | stats count AS failed_attempts dc(ClientIP) AS unique_ips values(ClientCountry) AS countries BY ClientASN | where failed_attempts > 100 | sort - failed_attempts | head 20 | rename ClientASN AS "ASN", failed_attempts AS "Failed Logins", unique_ips AS "Unique IPs", countries AS "Countries"

index=cloudflare sourcetype="cloudflare:logpush:http_requests" (ClientRequestURI="/login" OR ClientRequestURI="/api/auth" OR ClientRequestURI="/signin") ClientRequestMethod="POST" | stats count AS attempts dc(ClientIP) AS unique_ips sum(eval(if(EdgeResponseStatus>=400 AND EdgeResponseStatus<500,1,0))) AS failures BY ClientRequestUserAgent | eval failure_rate=round((failures/attempts)*100,2) | where attempts > 50 AND failure_rate > 90 | sort - attempts | head 15 | rename ClientRequestUserAgent AS "User Agent", attempts AS "Attempts", failure_rate AS "Failure %", unique_ips AS "Unique IPs"
